title: Revocation: communication and public offers
summary: Revocation withdraws an ordinary offer before effective acceptance, subject to limits such as an option.
notes: Hoover’s words could communicate unwillingness without the technical word “revoke.” For public rewards, equivalent publicity can serve where personal communication to every reader is infeasible. The notes ask whether removal of a posted notice achieves that purpose and whether the underlying offer was continuing. A stated period and an enforceable promise to hold open are different inquiries; the firm-offer and option provisions address the latter.
